feeds.title: Nutric Food Show
feeds.description: Nutric Food Show is about Nutritional Food facts and recipes which are equally good in taste and healthy. Healthy, easy recipes cooked in copper and clay pots add their own unique health benefits to each dish. We cover all dishes like chicken, beef, and vegetables in Asian and western styles.

feeds.title: Images.dawn.com » Food
feeds.description: All your lifestyle needs are met by Pakistan's hippest insider. In our food section of the blog, we talk about authentic Pakistani recipes that you will love if you're new to Pakistani cooking. Get authentic recipes, tips and tricks to make delicious dishes.

feeds.title: Youlin Magazine » Food
feeds.description: Youlin magazine is a joint venture between the Pakistan-China institute and the Cultural Exchange Association which seeks to improve Pakistan-China relations and Culture of Pakistan and China. Best reviews of popular and newly opened restaurants and cafes in Pakistan especially in Islamabad, Lahore and Karachi.

feeds.title: Tea For Turmeric
feeds.description: Meet Izzah, who is dedicated to brightening your day with good food and good vibes. On her food blog, you'll find tested-and-perfected South Asian recipes that are easy to follow yet authentic in taste. Her Pakistani and Indian recipes have been carefully tested and perfected to ensure that they are easy to follow and deliver authentic flavors

feeds.title: Untold Recipes By Nosheen
feeds.description: Nosheen welcomes you to her world of Authentic South Asian recipes and much more through her blog. Browse delicious authentic Pakistani & South Asian recipes passed down through generations and made with love on the Mississippi Gulf Coast. Nosheen's passion for food and tradition is evident in her carefully crafted dishes that showcase the rich flavors of South Asian cuisine.

feeds.title: The Express Tribune » Food
feeds.description: The Express Tribune keeps you up to date with all the latest happenings from Pakistan and across the world! We hope in particular to appeal to the young people of Pakistan, to serve their aspirations and their hopes. All the latest breaking news on Food. Browse The Express Tribune complete collection of articles and commentary on Food.

feeds.title: Karakoram Restaurant Blog
feeds.description: Step into Karakoram, a traditional Pakistani Restaurant with fine dining, and experience the treasured flavors and spices being prepared with perfection and with a spoonful of love. Indulge in an irresistible variety of flavors from Pakistan, as we present to you, plates of surprises with delights that befit the Taste of Lahore and Taste of Peshawar.

feeds.title: Flour & Spice Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to Flour & Spice, a food blog where you'll find Pakistani recipes, along with simple and quick weeknight dinners, desserts, and more delicious recipes. Flour & Spice, the foodie world of a Pakistani-origin Canadian mama of two whose busy life and love for food means practicality reigns supreme!

feeds.title: Recipe52.com
feeds.description: At Recipe52.com, we provide easy pictorial recipes to make cooking a fun experience. We strive to share techniques of cooking along with detailed steps. So to help understood connection of ingredients and how they react and even how to switch one ingredient for other. It is Pakistan's first step by step recipe blog. We shares both traditional and modern Pakistani food recipes.

feeds.title: Curry Flow » Food & Travel
feeds.description: Everything about Pakistani Food, Travel, Dramas & Pop Culture. CurryFlow seeks to provide refreshing thought-provoking content for the South Asian community back home and abroad. No topic is off-limits. This blog is the first stop for daily news and entertainment needs for thousands of Pakistanis, Indians and other people who look like us.

feeds.title: A Taste Of Pakistan In Fusion
feeds.description: My cookbook is an effort to open doors, build bridges and deepen relationships through the 'art' of fusion food. It melds my authentic Pakistani heritage with a celebration of American diversity. Author: 'Taste of Pakistan in Fusion'; blogger on a variety of subjects; cookbook is available for order online.

feeds.title: Foodies Blog
feeds.description: Bringing Pakistan's first food discovery platform for real foodies. Search your favorite food, give reviews, check out amazing recipes of top chefs and a lot more. Acquiring knowledge is an integral component of life, especially about food. Discover interesting food blogs, read them, and learn more! Let's Go Eat!

feeds.title: Pakistan Eats
feeds.description: If you are new to Pakistani cooking and have tried to look up recipes online, with the exception of a handful of excellent bloggers, you will be hard-pressed to find quality recipes that are truly representative of the diversity of the country. Pakistan Eats is an award-winning food blog that shares easy, classic Pakistani recipes that are accessible to modern home cooks everywhere.

feeds.title: Delightful Culinary Adventures
feeds.description: Embarking on a culinary journey can be a rewarding and mouthwatering experience. Whether you're an aspiring home chef or a cooking enthusiast, our blog is here to ignite your passion for food and cooking. In this flavorful guide, we'll dive into a world of delectable dishes, essential cooking techniques, and creative culinary ideas that will elevate your cooking game to new heights.

feeds.title: About Pakistan » Food
feeds.description: About Pakistan aims to empower every Pakistani anywhere in the world to start and grow their businesses with our smart marketing technology, inspiring content, and award-winning support. Their mission is to connect every Pakistani with every business in Pakistan, nurturing mutual growth. Go through their blog to know more about their mission and the information they are set to provide to their people.

feeds.title: Mirchi Tales
feeds.description: A food & lifestyle blog featuring simple & wholesome Pakistani recipes, travel adventures and a bit of Desi fusion. Find simple and authentic Pakistani and Indian recipes with a modern twist. With detailed step-by-step photos and expert tips South Asian cuisine has never been easier to make.

feeds.title: Pakistani Cooking Blog
feeds.description: A Pakistani Food blog with many Pakistani Recipes from the kitchen of a home cook. Click here for some easy-to-make comfort food! Find simple and authentic Pakistani and Indian recipes with a modern twist. With detailed step-by-step photos and expert tips.

feeds.title: Sabzi Khor
feeds.description: This is a Plant-Based Pakistani food blog but really is an expression of my healing and identity told through food. Sabzi Khor is a plant-based Pakistani food blog, with plant-based recipes and tips for cooking South Asian and Vegan food.

feeds.title: Fatima Cooks
feeds.description: The creation of this blog stemmed from my desire to help other people who want to cook but need some guidance in the same way I needed guidance too when I was a 20-year-old clueless Pakistani cook. I try my best to make my recipes as detailed as possible and include process pictures so you don't have to feel overwhelmed, confused and flustered over Pakistani cooking.

feeds.title: Blog Pakistan » Food Guide
feeds.description: BlogPakistan is an up-and-coming modern blog hub aiming to provide a fresh perspective on everyday Pakistan. A digital platform to promote Pakistani startups and local businesses and help them to improve their digital footprints. Since food blogging is a thing, we are here to share with you all about food guides, the best cuisines in town, and much more.

feeds.title: Pakistani Healthy Recipes
feeds.description: Pakistani Healthy Recipes is a Pakistani food blog featuring simple, delicious & time-tested recipes. A Pakistani food blog on simple and easy healthy recipes. Discover a huge collection of wholesome recipes from different cuisines around the world. Each recipe on our blog is tried and tested by our home chef. We bring it into the blog after it turns out delightful and perfect.

feeds.title: Pakistanichefs Blog
feeds.description: Our mission is to raise nutritional awareness among all sections of people, especially women and children, by publishing the information about health benefits and cooking methods of popular Pakistani dishes in the form of recipe books, articles and videos. Learn to make delicious Pakistani recipes with us.

feeds.title: The Recipes PK
feeds.description: The purpose behind making this blog is to put all my recipes in a single place. I am also sharing my friend's recipes so people can get authentic recipes and enjoy them with their families and guests. Here at The Recipes PK, we have compiled Mouthwatering, Easy To Cook, And Healthy, Authentic Pakistani Food Recipes for the whole family.
